About the Club

Every rally
starts with us

The Badminton Club, led by Ahmed Ahssan Samiul, is a friendly and active community where students come together to enjoy badminton, improve their skills, and have fun.

Through regular games and training sessions, we encourage teamwork, healthy competition, and a positive atmosphere for everyone.

Training

On the court,
every week

Our Badminton Club trains once or twice a week, depending on the available schedule and facilities. Training locations may vary between the North Campus and South Campus, while the choice between indoor and outdoor courts depends on the weather.

This flexible setup allows everyone to enjoy badminton comfortably throughout the year.

1–2x / week North & South Campus Indoor / Outdoor
